subject: Math
prompt: Which of the following expressions is equivalent to $\frac{(3x+2)}{(x-1)}+\frac{5}{(2x-2)}$?
explanation: The denominator $2x-2$ can be factored as $2(x-1)$. Rewriting the expression with this common denominator: $\frac{3x+2}{x-1}+\frac{5}{2(x-1)}=\frac{2(3x+2)}{2(x-1)}+\frac{5}{2(x-1)}=\frac{6x+4+5}{2(x-1)}=\frac{6x+9}{2x-2}$.
